packageRules.description: Cap Mockito at 5.22.0: 5.23.0's inline mock maker fails to instrument classes returning generated model.* types, poisoning the surefire JVM and cascading into ~120 unrelated test errors.

Stay on Java 21: Java 22+ fails the Oracle TCPS handshake (the database accepts only TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA; TLS_RSA_* is disabled by default, JDK-8245545; see OracleTlsCompatibility). Lift once the DB listener offers ECDHE ciphers, moving the runtime image, the Maven build image and <java.version> in pom.xml together.
